tools.name: help
tools.description: Read static help without an MCP Token, model call or credit charge. All help topics are available. Returns topic, steps, examples, documentation/setup links and versions. Account, billing and generation topics describe authenticated operations; they do not read personal data or execute work. Anonymo

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Read the public image-model catalog. Returns scope, accountAuthorization=not_evaluated, models (id, status=listed, offers with parameters and public credit prices), pricingSource and visibleCount. priceSemantics=public_sale_exact; prices retain three decimals, free offers are zero and missing pricin

tools.name: prompts
tools.description: Read public prompts without an MCP Token, model call or credit charge. search (default) queries published, reviewed system recommendations; get reads a currently public detail by the id returned from search. scope must be omitted or recommended; mine, favorites and private data remain authenticated.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_models" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
